decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed single storey side extension, by way of its size, scale, design and appearance, would be a visually incongruous feature that would not be in proportion to the dynamics of the existing dwelling and would consequently be detrimental to its appearance and the character of the local street scene and is therefore contrary with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is not compliant with the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

INFORMATIVE

A revised application involving a 1m. set back from the front elevation of the house, and an amended roof design, would be likely to receive favorable consideration. Such a revised proposal should be discussed with the Borough Planning Department before a formal resubmission.
description: The erection of single storey side extension to dwellinghouse.
